rules.name: AI — Unauthorized Model Deployment
rules.description: Detects deployment of AI models without proper approval or governance review
rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "unauthorized" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 1 // AZ-AI-GOV-004

rules.name: AI — Bias Detection Alert
rules.description: Detects AI model outputs exhibiting statistical bias across protected demographic groups
rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "bias" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-GOV-005

rules.name: AI — Missing Model Documentation
rules.description: Detects AI models operating without required documentation including model cards and impact assessments
rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "missing" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 1 // AZ-AI-GOV-006

rules.name: AI — Decision Without Human Oversight
rules.description: Detects high-stakes AI decisions made without required human oversight or review
rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "decision" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 1 // AZ-AI-GOV-007

rules.name: AI — Regulatory Compliance Violation
rules.description: Detects AI operations that violate regulatory requirements including EU AI Act, GDPR, and industry standards
rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "regulatory" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 1 // AZ-AI-GOV-008

rules.name: AI — Explainability Requirement Violation

rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "explainability" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 3 // AZ-AI-GOV-009
